# 1. Proclaim the New Yassa Charter (army steppe horde -> landed gunpowder monarchy)
oe_pglh_dec_charter_sedentary_steppe = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_pglh_is_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_settled_empire }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_sedentary_anchor_tt
			oe_pglh_controls_sedentary_anchor = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_sedentary_req_tt
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_sedentary }
				var:oe_pglh_sedentary >= 75
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		stability >= 5
		gold >= 200
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pglh_dec_charter_sedentary_steppe.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pglh_dec_charter_sedentary_steppe_tt
			add_gold = -200
			oe_pglh_enact_sedentary_empire = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_8 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_8 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.8
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Excavate the Volga-Don Canal across Perevolok (3 stages)
oe_pglh_dec_dig_volga_don_canal = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pglh_is_host = yes
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage }
			var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage < 3
		}
		trigger_else = { always = yes }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		owns = location:astrakhan
		owns = location:tana
		gold >= 600
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_canal_stage_req_tt
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage }
				var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage < 3
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_canal_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_canal_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:peasants } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pglh_dec_dig_volga_don_canal.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pglh_dec_dig_volga_don_canal_tt
			add_gold = -600
			set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_canal_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			oe_pglh_advance_volga_canal = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage
					var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage >= 3
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_10 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_10 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.10
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Assemble Steppe Tabur Wagon-Fort & Zamburak Corps (up to tier 4)
oe_pglh_dec_assemble_tabur_corps = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pglh_is_host = yes
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_tabur_tier }
			var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier < 4
		}
		trigger_else = { always = yes }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 250
		stability >= -10
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_tabur_tier_req_tt
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_tabur_tier }
				var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier < 4
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pglh_tabur_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_tabur_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pglh_dec_assemble_tabur_corps.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pglh_dec_assemble_tabur_corps_tt
			add_gold = -250
			set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_tabur_cd value = 1 years = 8 }
			oe_pglh_bump_tabur = { amount = 1 }
			add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
		}
	}
}
